# ghost/librebible

LibreBible (F-Droid): browse the Latin Vulgate offline, open a book and chapter and read its verses. No account.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/librebible
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/librebible open_books --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/librebible list_books --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/librebible open_chapter --device <serial> --param book=<book> --param chapter=<chapter>
ghost skill run ghost/librebible read_chapter --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `open_books`: Open the LibreBible book list
- `list_books`: List all books in LibreBible
- `open_chapter`: Open Ruth chapter 1 in LibreBible
- `read_chapter`: Read the open chapter in LibreBible
